facts.claim: 研究需要一种通用的大语言模型幻觉检测方法，能够处理新的、未见过的问题，包括人类可能也不知道答案的问题。
facts.quote: Researchers need a general method for detecting hallucinations in LLMs that works even with new and unseen questions to which humans might not know the answer.
facts.subject: Researchers
facts.condition: even with new and unseen questions to which humans might not know the answer

facts.claim: 通过监督或强化来鼓励模型如实回答，目前只取得了部分成功。
facts.quote: Encouraging truthfulness through supervision or reinforcement has been only partially successful8.
facts.subject: Encouraging truthfulness through supervision or reinforcement

facts.claim: 作者提出基于统计学和熵的不确定性估计方法，用来检测幻觉中的一个子类，即任意生成且不正确的回答，文中称为confabulations。
facts.quote: Here we develop new methods grounded in statistics, proposing entropy-based uncertainty estimators for LLMs to detect a subset of hallucinations—confabulations—which are arbitrary and incorrect generations.
facts.subject: entropy-based uncertainty estimators for LLMs
facts.condition: to detect a subset of hallucinations—confabulations—which are arbitrary and incorrect generations

facts.claim: 同一个意思可以有多种表达方式，因此该方法在含义层面计算不确定性，而不是针对具体的词语序列计算。
facts.quote: Our method addresses the fact that one idea can be expressed in many ways by computing uncertainty at the level of meaning rather than specific sequences of words.
facts.subject: Our method
facts.metric: uncertainty at the level of meaning
facts.condition: rather than specific sequences of words

facts.claim: 作者报告，该方法无需预先了解任务，也无需任务专用数据，能够跨数据集和任务使用，并稳健地推广到此前未见过的新任务。
facts.quote: Our method works across datasets and tasks without a priori knowledge of the task, requires no task-specific data and robustly generalizes to new tasks not seen before.
facts.subject: Our method
facts.condition: without a priori knowledge of the task

facts.claim: 面对同一个关于Sotorasib靶点的医学问题，即使指令完全相同，大语言模型有时回答正确的KRASG12 ‘C’，有时回答错误的KRASG12 ‘D’；作者以此说明所研究的任意错误生成。
facts.quote:
For example, when asked a medical question “What is the target of Sotorasib?” an LLM confabu-
lates by sometimes answering KRASG12 ‘C’ (correct) and other times KRASG12 ‘D’ (incorrect) despite identical instructions.
facts.subject: an LLM
facts.condition: despite identical instructions

facts.claim: 作者将所研究的任意错误生成，与由其他机制导致的类似错误区分开来：因训练数据错误而持续答错、为追求奖励而“说谎”，以及推理或泛化的系统性失败。
facts.quote: We distinguish this from cases in which a similar ‘symptom’ is caused by the following different mechanisms: when LLMs are consistently wrong as a result of being trained on erroneous data such as common misconceptions13; when the LLM ‘lies’ in pursuit of a reward14; or systematic failures of reasoning or generalization.
facts.subject: LLMs
facts.condition: being trained on erroneous data such as common misconceptions13

facts.claim: 该方法不保证回答符合事实，因为当大语言模型的输出存在系统性问题时，它无法提供帮助。
facts.quote: However, it does not guarantee factuality because it does not help when LLM outputs are systematically bad.
facts.subject: it
facts.condition: when LLM outputs are systematically bad

facts.claim: 作者报告显著提高了当前先进大语言模型的问答准确率，并认为这一结果表明，所研究的任意错误生成是当前错误的重要来源。
facts.quote: we significantly improve question-answering accuracy for state-of-the-art LLMs, revealing that confabulations are a great source of error at present.
facts.subject: state-of-the-art LLMs
facts.condition: for state-of-the-art LLMs

facts.claim: 作者通过构建定量指标，检测哪些输入容易使大语言模型产生任意且缺乏依据的回答。
facts.quote:
We show how to detect confabulations by developing a quantita -
tive measure of when an input is likely to cause an LLM to generate arbitrary and ungrounded answers.
facts.subject: an input
facts.condition: when an input is likely to cause an LLM to generate arbitrary and ungrounded answers

facts.claim: 检测这类任意错误生成后，基于大语言模型的系统可以避答容易引发此类错误的问题、提醒用户答案不可靠，或用依据更充分的搜索或检索来补充模型。
facts.quote: Detecting confabulations allows systems built on LLMs to avoid answering questions likely to cause confabulations, to make users aware of the unreliability of answers to a question or to supplement the LLM with more grounded search or retrieval.
facts.subject: systems built on LLMs
facts.condition: Detecting confabulations

facts.claim: 作者使用概率工具定义并测量模型生成内容的语义熵，即在句子含义层面计算的熵。熵越高，对应的不确定性越高，因此语义熵可用于估计语义层面的不确定性。
facts.quote: T o detect confabulations, we use probabilistic tools to define and then measure the ‘semantic’ entropy of the generations of an LLM—an entropy that is computed over meanings of sentences. High entropy corresponds to high uncertainty23–25—so semantic entropy is one way to estimate semantic uncertainties.
facts.subject: ‘semantic’ entropy
facts.condition: computed over meanings of sentences

facts.claim: 自由文本生成中，不同措辞可能表达相同含义，因此直接根据字面变化估计熵（用于衡量不确定性的指标），可能把同一个正确答案的多种表达误判为较高的不确定性。
facts.quote:
Entropy 
in free-form generation is normally hard to measure because answers 
might mean the same thing (be semantically equivalent) despite being 
expressed differently (being syntactically or lexically distinct). This 
causes naive estimates of entropy or other lexical variation scores26 to 
be misleadingly high when the same correct answer might be written 
in many ways without changing its meaning.
facts.subject: naive estimates of entropy or other lexical variation scores26
facts.condition:
when the same correct answer might be written 
in many ways without changing its meaning

facts.claim: 语义熵先对每个问题抽样生成多个答案，再按含义聚类；判断标准是双向蕴含，即答案A能推出答案B为真，答案B也能反过来推出答案A为真。
facts.quote:
Intuitively, our method works by sampling several possible answers 
to each question and clustering them algorithmically into answers that 
have similar meanings, which we determine on the basis of whether 
answers in the same cluster entail each other bidirectionally28. That 
is, if sentence A entails that sentence B is true and vice versa, then we 
consider them to be in the same semantic cluster.
facts.subject: our method
facts.condition: if sentence A entails that sentence B is true and vice versa

facts.claim: 研究使用通用大语言模型和自然语言推理工具测量答案之间的蕴含关系；这里的自然语言推理工具专门用于判断一句话是否能推出另一句话。
facts.quote:
We measure entail-
ment using both general-purpose LLMs and natural language inference 
(NLI) tools developed specifically for detecting entailment for which 
we show direct evaluations in Supplementary Tables 2 and 3 and Sup-
plementary Fig. 1.
facts.subject: We
facts.condition:
using both general-purpose LLMs and natural language inference 
(NLI) tools developed specifically for detecting entailment

facts.claim: 作者报告，语义熵能在不预先掌握领域知识的条件下，检测多种语言模型和领域中的自由文本编造内容；问答评估涵盖趣闻知识、一般知识、生命科学，以及来自真实谷歌搜索查询的开放领域问题。
facts.quote:
Semantic entropy detects confabulations in free-form text genera-
tion across a range of language models and domains, without previous 
domain knowledge. Our evaluations cover question answering in trivia 
knowledge (TriviaQA32), general knowledge (SQuAD 1.1; ref. 33), life 
sciences (BioASQ34) and open-domain natural questions (NQ-Open35) 
derived from actual queries to Google Search36.
facts.subject: Semantic entropy
facts.condition:
across a range of language models and domains, without previous 
domain knowledge

facts.claim: 作者还报告，语义熵可以检测数学应用题数据集SVAMP，以及随论文提供的人物传记生成数据集FactualBio中的编造内容。
facts.quote:
In addition, seman-
tic entropy detects confabulations in mathematical word problems 
(SVAMP37) and in a biography-generation dataset, FactualBio, accom-
panying this paper.
facts.subject:
seman-
tic entropy
facts.condition:
in mathematical word problems 
(SVAMP37) and in a biography-generation dataset, FactualBio

facts.claim: TriviaQA、SQuAD、BioASQ、NQ-Open和SVAMP均在不提供上下文的条件下评估，答案为句子长度，字符数为96 ± 70，表示均值 ± 标准差。所用模型包括LLaMA 2 Chat、Falcon Instruct和Mistral Instruct，引文列出了各自的参数规模。
facts.quote:
Our results for TriviaQA, SQuAD, BioASQ, NQ-Open and SVAMP are 
all evaluated context-free and involve sentence-length answers (96 ± 70 
characters, mean ± s.d.) and use LLaMA 2 Chat (7B, 13B and 70B param-
eters)38, Falcon Instruct (7B and 40B)39 and Mistral Instruct (7B)40.
facts.subject: TriviaQA, SQuAD, BioASQ, NQ-Open and SVAMP
facts.condition: all evaluated context-free and involve sentence-length answers

facts.claim: FactualBio实验使用GPT-4，文本长度为442 ± 122个字符。
facts.quote:
Results for FactualBio (442 ± 122 characters) use GPT-4 
(ref. 1).
facts.subject: FactualBio
facts.condition: use GPT-4

facts.claim: 由于写作时GPT-4尚不开放输出概率或隐藏状态，作者提出语义熵估计量的离散近似，使实验无需访问输出概率。论文所有GPT-4结果都使用该近似，作者称其表现相近；文中同时说明GPT-4后来已开放这些信息。输出概率指模型为输出赋予的概率，隐藏状态指模型内部的表示。
facts.quote:
At the time of writing, GPT-4 (ref. 1) did not expose output prob-
abilities41 or hidden states, although it does now. As a result, we propose 
a discrete approximation of our estimator for semantic entropy which 
allows us to run experiments without access to output probabilities, 
which we use for all GPT-4 results in this paper and which performs 
similarly well.
facts.subject: a discrete approximation of our estimator for semantic entropy
facts.condition: without access to output probabilities

facts.claim: 图1用“Paris”“It’s Paris”和“France’s capital Paris”说明字面差异与含义差异的区别：朴素熵把它们视为不同答案，语义熵则先将含义相同的答案归为一组，再计算熵。
facts.quote:
Naive 
entropy-based uncertainty measures variation in the exact answers, treating 
‘Paris’, ‘It’s Paris’ and ‘France’s capital Paris’ as different. But this is unsuitable 
for language tasks for which sometimes different answers mean the same 
things. Our semantic entropy clusters answers which share meanings before 
computing the entropy.
facts.subject: Our semantic entropy
facts.condition:
clusters answers which share meanings before 
computing the entropy

facts.claim: 低语义熵表示语言模型对答案含义具有较高信心。
facts.quote:
A low semantic entropy shows that the LLM is confident 
about the meaning.
facts.subject: the LLM
facts.condition: A low semantic entropy

facts.claim: 对较长文本，方法先将生成答案拆成简短事实陈述，再让一个语言模型为每条陈述生成可能对应的问题，由原语言模型对这些问题抽样生成M个可能答案。随后，对每个具体问题的答案连同原始事实陈述一起计算语义熵；与某条陈述相关的问题具有较高平均语义熵，被用作该陈述可能属于编造内容的信号。
facts.quote:
We automatically decompose a long generated answer into 
factoids. For each factoid, an LLM generates questions to which that factoid 
might have been the answer. The original LLM then samples M possible answers 
to these questions. Finally, we compute the semantic entropy over the answers 
to each specific question, including the original factoid. Confabulations are 
indicated by high average semantic entropy for questions associated with that 
factoid.
facts.subject: The original LLM
facts.condition:
for questions associated with that 
factoid

facts.claim: 图1中，语义熵将事实1判为很可能不是编造内容，因为生成答案虽然措辞差异很大，却经常表达同样含义；作者指出，朴素熵会漏掉这种含义上的一致性。
facts.quote:
Here, semantic entropy classifies Fact 1 as probably not a confabulation 
because generations often mean the same thing, despite very different 
wordings, which a naive entropy would have missed.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition:
because generations often mean the same thing, despite very different 
wordings

facts.claim: 本研究方法采用无监督方式，即不需要带有编造错误标签的示例。
facts.quote:
Our method is unsupervised, meaning that we do not 
need labelled examples of confabulations.
facts.subject: Our method

facts.claim: 监督方法从编造错误示例中学习模式，假设未来问题仍保留这些模式；作者指出，在新情境或人类监督者无法识别的编造错误中，这一假设往往不成立。
facts.quote:
By contrast, supervised 
methods detect confabulations by learning patterns behind examples 
of confabulations, assuming that future questions preserve these pat-
terns. But this assumption is often untrue in new situations or with 
confabulations that human overseers are unable to identify (com -
pare Fig. 17 of ref. 24).
facts.subject:
supervised 
methods
facts.condition:
in new situations or with 
confabulations that human overseers are unable to identify

facts.claim: 研究采用嵌入回归作为强监督基线：根据大语言模型最终的嵌入，即隐藏状态，训练逻辑回归分类器，预测模型是否正确回答问题。
facts.quote:
As a strong supervised baseline, we compare 
to an embedding regression method inspired by ref. 24 which trains 
a logistic regression classifier to predict whether the model correctly 
answered a question on the basis of the final ‘embedding’ (hidden state) 
of the LLM.
facts.subject: an embedding regression method
facts.condition:
on the basis of the final ‘embedding’ (hidden state) 
of the LLM

facts.claim: 另一项比较方法P(True)通过少量示例提示，让大语言模型比较主要答案与“头脑风暴”产生的备选答案，并查看模型预测下一个词元为“True”的概率。
facts.quote:
We also use the P(True) method24 which looks at the prob-
ability with which an LLM predicts that the next token is ‘True’ when 
few-shot prompted to compare a main answer with ‘brainstormed’ 
alternatives.
facts.subject: the P(True) method24
facts.metric:
the prob-
ability with which an LLM predicts that the next token is ‘True’
facts.condition:
when 
few-shot prompted to compare a main answer with ‘brainstormed’ 
alternatives

facts.claim: 作者报告，语义熵可用于预测许多模型错误答案，也可通过拒绝回答模型不确定的问题来提高问答准确率；语义熵在这里用作检测编造错误的不确定性指标。
facts.quote:
We show that semantic entropy can be used to pre-
dict many incorrect model answers and to improve question-answering 
accuracy by refusing to answer those questions the model is uncertain 
about.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition:
by refusing to answer those questions the model is uncertain 
about

facts.claim: 研究用接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评价对答案是否错误的判别能力。按作者描述，该指标兼顾精确率与召回率，取值为0到1；1表示完美分类器，0.5表示没有信息量的分类器。这是错误检测指标，不能直接当作问答准确率。
facts.quote:
First, the widely used area under the receiver operating characteristic 
(AUROC) curve for the binary event that a given answer is incorrect. 
This measure captures both precision and recall and ranges from 
0 to 1, with 1 representing a perfect classifier and 0.5 representing 
an un-informative classifier.
facts.subject:
area under the receiver operating characteristic 
(AUROC) curve
facts.condition: for the binary event that a given answer is incorrect

facts.claim: 研究还使用拒答准确率曲线下面积（AURAC）：按检测分数拒绝回答最可能引发编造错误的问题，再计算剩余问题的回答准确率，并用曲线下面积概括多个阈值下的表现。
facts.quote:
We also show a new measure, the area 
under the ‘rejection accuracy’ curve (AURAC). This studies the case in 
which the confabulation detection score is used to refuse to answer 
the questions judged most likely to cause confabulations. Rejection 
accuracy is the accuracy of the answers of the model on the remaining 
questions and the area under this curve is a summary statistic over 
many thresholds (representative threshold accuracies are provided in 
Supplementary Material).
facts.subject:
the area 
under the ‘rejection accuracy’ curve (AURAC)
facts.metric:
the accuracy of the answers of the model on the remaining 
questions
facts.condition:
the confabulation detection score is used to refuse to answer 
the questions judged most likely to cause confabulations

facts.claim: 在句子长度的生成任务中，语义熵及其离散近似均优于研究采用的最佳基线；所报告结果是留出评估数据集上的实际分数，并跨数据集取平均。
facts.quote:
In Fig. 2, we show that both semantic entropy and its discrete approxi-
mation outperform our best baselines for sentence-length generations. 
These results are averaged across datasets and provide the actual scores 
on the held-out evaluation dataset.
facts.subject:
both semantic entropy and its discrete approxi-
mation
facts.condition: for sentence-length generations

facts.claim: 作者报告留出评估数据集上的原始平均分，不提供标准误；其理由是，分布特征更多取决于所选模型与数据集，而不是方法。在这种情况下，作者认为跨数据集相对结果的一致性更能反映变异情况。
facts.quote:
We report the raw average score 
across held-out evaluation datasets without standard error because 
the distributional characteristics are more a property of the models 
and datasets selected than the method. Consistency of relative results 
across different datasets is a stronger indicator of variation in this case.
facts.subject: We
facts.condition: across held-out evaluation datasets

facts.claim: 语义熵大幅优于朴素熵估计。这里的朴素方法对经过长度归一化的词元序列联合概率计算熵；其局限在于，词元概率也反映模型在不同措辞之间的不确定性，而这些措辞变化可能不改变输出含义。
facts.quote:
Semantic entropy greatly outperforms the naive estimation of uncer-
tainty using entropy: computing the entropy of the length-normalized 
joint probability of the token sequences. Naive entropy estimation 
ignores the fact that token probabilities also express the uncertainty of 
the model over phrasings that do not change the meaning of an output.
facts.subject: Semantic entropy
facts.condition:
computing the entropy of the length-normalized 
joint probability of the token sequences

facts.claim: 研究方法在分布内和分布外条件下都优于监督式嵌入回归方法，即训练与部署数据分布相符或不同的两类条件。
facts.quote:
Our methods also outperform the supervised embedding regression 
method both in- and out-of-distribution.
facts.subject: Our methods
facts.condition: both in- and out-of-distribution

facts.claim: 当训练数据与部署数据的分布不匹配时，嵌入回归性能下降。图中浅黄色柱所示数值，是在四个分布外数据集之一上训练嵌入回归后，针对该项评估得到的指标平均值。
facts.quote:
In pale-yellow bars we show 
that embedding regression performance deteriorates when its train-
ing data do not match the deployment distribution—which mirrors the 
common real-world case in which there is a distribution shift between 
training and deployment42—the plotted value is the average metric for 
embedding regression trained on one of the four ‘off-distribution’ 
datasets for that evaluation.
facts.subject: embedding regression
facts.condition:
when its train-
ing data do not match the deployment distribution

facts.claim: 语义熵也优于P(True)；后者通过在大语言模型提示中提供少量训练示例，以“上下文内”监督方式适应部署任务。
facts.quote:
Semantic entropy 
also outperforms P(True) which is supervised ‘in-context’; that is, it is 
adapted to the deployment task with a few training examples provided 
in the LLM prompt itself.
facts.subject: Semantic entropy
facts.condition: P(True) which is supervised ‘in-context’

facts.claim: 语义熵的离散变体不需要精确的输出概率，其表现与标准估计方法相近。
facts.quote:
The discrete variant of semantic entropy per-
forms similarly to our standard estimator, despite not requiring exact 
output probabilities.
facts.subject: The discrete variant of semantic entropy
facts.condition:
despite not requiring exact 
output probabilities

facts.claim: 在研究的30种任务与模型组合上取平均，语义熵的AUROC为0.790，优于朴素熵的0.691、P(True)的0.698和嵌入回归基线的0.687。这些数值表示错误检测表现，不能解读为回答正确的比例。
facts.quote:
Averaged across the 30 combinations of tasks and models we study, 
semantic entropy achieves the best AUROC value of 0.790 whereas 
naive entropy (0.691), P(True) (0.698) and the embedding regression 
baseline (0.687) lag behind it.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition: Averaged across the 30 combinations of tasks and models we study

facts.claim: 图2的结果是五个数据集的平均值；各项单独指标见补充信息。
facts.quote:
Results are an average over five 
datasets, with individual metrics provided in the Supplementary Information.
facts.subject: Results
